instruction: Review the household move-out settlement HM-37 using the available sources. Calculate the final security-deposit, utility, and side-adjustment settlement for Unit 4B roommates Alex, Bri, and Chen. Use only the final lease/housemate rules, final property statement, valid deposit ledger rows, inspection evidence, utilities through 2026-03-31 including utility rows that must be prorated through that date, final approved side-adjustment workbook rows, and the final roommate approval thread for side rows that require thread approval. For utility rows spanning the cutoff, prorate only when the source row/rules say to prorate; for side adjustments, apply each included row's allocation_rule. Side adjustment rows marked requires_thread_approval are included only if the approval thread shows explicit approval from Alex, Bri, and Chen before 2026-04-06. Exclude preliminary estimates, withdrawn charges, other-unit rows, voided deposit rows, preexisting damage, weather-related damage, personal subscriptions, unapproved purchases, post-move-out utility periods, draft workbook rows, old draft workbook tabs, personal side expenses, duplicate side expenses, and side expenses without all-roommate approval. Return only a JSON object with these fields: landlord_deduction_total, refund_pool, alex_landlord_deduction_share, bri_landlord_deduction_share, chen_landlord_deduction_share, alex_utility_adjustment, bri_utility_adjustment, chen_utility_adjustment, alex_final_refund, bri_final_refund, chen_final_refund, side_adjustment_total, alex_side_adjustment, bri_side_adjustment, chen_side_adjustment, alex_final_payout, bri_final_payout, chen_final_payout, approved_deduction_ids, excluded_property_statement_ids, valid_deposit_people, excluded_deposit_row_ids, included_utility_bill_ids, excluded_utility_bill_ids, included_side_adjustment_ids, excluded_side_adjustment_ids, refund_check_to_lead_tenant, preliminary_estimate_conflict, roommate_reimbursement_needed. Field definitions: landlord_deduction_total is the sum of final landlord security-deposit deductions only. refund_pool is total valid security deposit minus landlord_deduction_total before roommate utility and side adjustments. Each *_landlord_deduction_share is that roommate's share of landlord deductions under the housemate allocation rules. Each *_utility_adjustment is amount paid by that roommate for the included portion of utilities minus that roommate's responsibility for included utilities; positive means the roommate should receive more from the settlement, negative means the roommate should receive less. Each *_final_refund is that roommate's valid deposit contribution minus landlord deduction share plus utility adjustment, before side adjustments. side_adjustment_total is the total amount of included final side-adjustment rows. Each *_side_adjustment is amount paid by that roommate for included side adjustments minus that roommate's responsibility under each included side-adjustment allocation_rule. Each *_final_payout is that roommate's final_refund plus side_adjustment. approved_deduction_ids must contain the item_id values from final_property_statement_hm37.csv for final landlord deductions accepted into the settlement. excluded_property_statement_ids must contain the item_id values from final_property_statement_hm37.csv that are excluded from the settlement. valid_deposit_people must contain the person names from deposit_contributions_hm37.csv whose rows are valid_final for Unit 4B. excluded_deposit_row_ids must contain the row_id values from deposit_contributions_hm37.csv that are excluded from the settlement. included_utility_bill_ids must contain bill_id values from final_utilities_hm37.csv included in the roommate utility settlement. excluded_utility_bill_ids must contain bill_id values from final_utilities_hm37.csv excluded from the roommate utility settlement. included_side_adjustment_ids must contain adjustment_id values from side_adjustment_workbook_hm37.xlsx included in the roommate side-adjustment settlement. excluded_side_adjustment_ids must contain adjustment_id values from side_adjustment_workbook_hm37.xlsx excluded from the roommate side-adjustment settlement. refund_check_to_lead_tenant, preliminary_estimate_conflict, and roommate_reimbursement_needed must be booleans directly determined from the sources. Numeric fields must be dollar amounts rounded to two decimals. ID array fields must use exact source IDs, not free-form descriptive labels. For every array field, include all and only the source IDs directly supported by the sources; do not add speculative, generic, duplicate, or unsupported labels. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: Valid deposit rows are DEP_ALEX_VALID, DEP_BRI_VALID, and DEP_CHEN_VALID for Alex 1200, Bri 1050, Chen 750, total 3000, giving deposit shares 40%, 35%, 25%. Final landlord deduction item_ids are F1 285, F2 45, F3 420, and F4 130, total 880; refund pool is 3000-880=2120. Excluded property statement item_ids are X1, X2, D1, and N1. Excluded deposit row_ids are DEP_ALEX_VOIDED_TOPUP and DEP_DANA_4C. Included utility bill_ids are U1, U2, U3, and U7; excluded utility bill_ids are U4, U5, U6, U8, and U9. Shared/unknown deductions are F1+F2=330, allocated by deposit share: Alex 132, Bri 115.50, Chen 82.50. F3 is charged only to Chen, and F4 only to Bri, so landlord deduction shares are Alex 132.00, Bri 245.50, Chen 502.50. Utilities through 2026-03-31: U1 electricity 192.60 paid by Alex, with 36.00 EV add-on to Alex and remaining 156.60 split equally, so Alex's electric responsibility is 88.20 and Bri/Chen each 52.20. U2 water/trash 96 paid by Chen is split equally at 32 each. U3 internet 75 paid by Bri is split equally at 25 each. U7 gas spans 2026-03-20 to 2026-04-04, 16 inclusive days; include 12 days through 2026-03-31, so 144*(12/16)=108, split equally at 36 each and treated as Chen paid 108 for settlement. Utility responsibilities are Alex 181.20, Bri 145.20, Chen 145.20; included paid amounts are Alex 192.60, Bri 75.00, Chen 204.00, so utility net adjustments are Alex +11.40, Bri -70.20, Chen +58.80. Final refunds before side adjustments are Alex 1079.40, Bri 734.30, Chen 306.30. Included side adjustment IDs are SA1 18 paid by Alex, SA2 90 paid by Bri, SA3 6 paid by Alex, SA10 75 paid by Chen, and SA13 84 paid by Alex, total 273. SA1-SA3 are equal split: 114/3=38 each. SA10 and SA13 are deposit_share, total 159, allocated Alex 63.60, Bri 55.65, Chen 39.75. Side responsibilities are Alex 101.60, Bri 93.65, Chen 77.75; paid totals are Alex 108.00, Bri 90.00, Chen 75.00, so side adjustments are Alex +6.40, Bri -3.65, Chen -2.75. Final payouts after side adjustments are Alex 1085.80, Bri 730.65, Chen 303.55. SA13 is included because the roommate approval thread shows Alex, Bri, and Chen all approved it before 2026-04-06. Excluded side adjustment IDs are SA4, SA5, SA6, SA7, SA8, SA9, SA11, SA12, SA14, SA15, OLD1, OLD2, and OLD3. SA14 and SA15 are excluded because the approval thread does not show unanimous approval. refund_check_to_lead_tenant=true because the refund check was issued only to Alex. preliminary_estimate_conflict=true because the preliminary quote conflicts with the final statement. roommate_reimbursement_needed=true because utility and side-adjustment payers and responsibilities differ.
